newsitem.title: USA: Mattel sees Tyco deal in first half.
newsitem.headline: Mattel sees Tyco deal in first half.

text.p: Mattel Inc said it still expects to complete its proposed $755 million merger with Tyco Toys Inc in the first half of 1997.
In late December, the Federal Trade Commission asked for more information regarding the proposed merger.

"With respect to the Tyco merger, we're actively working on ther response to the Federal and Trade Commission's second request and we're finalizing our registration statement," said an attorney for Mattel.
"We continue to have every belief that the merger will close in the first half of this year," he said.
Tyco set a shareholder meeeting to vote on the merger on March 18.
